question: A 15-year-old girl is brought to the physician for her annual physical examination. Breast and pubic hair development began at the age of 12 years, but menses have not yet occurred. She is 160 cm (5 ft 3 in) tall and weighs 54 kg (120 lb); BMI is 21 kg/m2. Physical examination shows normal external genitalia. Breast and pubic hair development are Tanner stage 5. A pelvic ultrasound shows normal ovaries but an absent uterus. These findings are most likely due to a defect in which of the following embryologic structures?
